title: Figure 11: Solid-core positron rocket engine with hot-bleed configuration
description: Cross-section schematic of a solid-core positron rocket engine compared in the text to the NERVA nuclear-thermal concept. Labeled components include "H2 Flow," "Turbopump," "H2 Tank," "Attenuating HX," "Positron Trap," "Hot Bleed Line," "Inlet Plenum" and "Turbine & Exhaust Nozzle," with arrows showing propellant flow through the nozzle. Caption: "Figure 11. Solid-Core Positron Rocket Engine With a Hot-Bleed Configuration (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)."
